raw.commentary: Layer is dominated by two whole-film retellings (Awakening and Identity Crisis) that inflate P1-P3 and destroy P5; Rescue, Betrayal and Choice are tighter but overlap heavily and misplace members, leaving only P4 partially intact via forced extensions to ev-047.
